exposure: counseling on timely initiation of breastfeeding
assistance by health professionals during delivery
cohort: The study included 1000 mothers with children less than 12 months of age, with 500 mothers participating in the analysis.
finding: Mothers reported an 80% prevalence of timely commencement of breastfeeding, with male infant, nuclear family, spontaneous vaginal birth, and ANC advice on timely breastfeeding initiation being associated factors.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal birth was statistically associated with early breastfeeding initiation.
cross-section timing: Data was collected when infants were less than 12 months old, retrospectively assessing breastfeeding initiation.
